description: Extracts seller/buyer invoice fields (contact details, line items, tax, totals) using a labeled training dataset.
note: analyzer.json is the single mutable source of truth, tracked by git. Each promoted version is tagged in git (git tag test01-vN) and deployed to Azure under a distinct analyzerId (lowercase, e.g. test01v1) so multiple historical versions can be live and compared side by side. Run scripts/promote-analyzer.ps1 to tag + deploy + record a new entry here.
